page_title: Voice Dream Reader - Text to Speech App

sources.entry: 20. Voice Dream - Text-to-speech app for mobile devices.

summary.name: Voice Dream Reader
summary.one_liner: Voice Dream Reader is a text-to-speech app that turns PDFs, web pages, articles, and books into audio for listening on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
use_cases: listening to PDFs and reports on a commute
reading with braille display alongside audio
accessible reading for people with visual or reading disabilities
summary.what_it_does: The app converts PDFs, articles, reports, and books into audio so they can be listened to on the go. Users can choose a voice and adjust speed, pronunciation, and playback settings. Listening works offline, and the reading library continues across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Readers can highlight passages, add notes, and export their work. The page says the app supports VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, Voice Control, and refreshable braille displays.
notable: Full VoiceOver support and Voice Control navigation
Offline listening synced across iPhone, iPad, and Mac
Featured by Apple as Best New App and App of the Day in 81 countries (per meta description)
caveats: Free trial is mentioned; full access appears to require payment, but exact pricing is not stated on the page
Platforms named are iPhone, iPad, and Mac only
